name: 立陶宛工作临时居留许可
nameEn: Lithuania temporary residence permit for work
summary: 面向依据工作合同或有约束力工作邀请在立陶宛就业，并满足适用审批条件的第三国公民。
summaryEn: For third-country nationals working in Lithuania under an employment contract or binding job offer who meet the applicable approval rules.

jobOffer.summary: 须有符合该路径要求的工作邀请、合同或雇主安排。
jobOffer.summaryEn: A job offer, contract or employer arrangement meeting the route rules is required.

qualification.summary: 职位、雇主或法律要求时，须提交适用技能、资格或专业认可证明。
qualification.summaryEn: Skill, qualification or professional-recognition evidence is required when the role, employer or law requires it.

assessment.summary: 须通过申请时适用的工资、担保、职位登记、劳动力市场或其他主管机关审查。
assessment.summaryEn: Any salary, sponsorship, vacancy-registration, labour-market or other authority assessment in force when applying must be met.

disclaimer: 本资料仅供一般教育用途，不构成个性化移民或法律建议。
